reviews.title: Since When Does Tracking COST?
reviews.text: I have used this app so many times when purchasing items from overseas. Then today, I downloaded it to my new iPhone and as soon as I open it, I can’t track a darn package without choosing how much I’m going to pay! This is getting ridiculous. Everything requires a subscription, now including package tracking apps. We are being bled dry just to function in society. Maybe I’m just old-fashioned, but I’ll pass. At some point enough becomes enough. If the app was free for years, what’s the logic for NOW requiring a subscription to use it? The answer is simple. They do it because they can. Bottom line is they make money whether you track one package or 10. Requiring a subscription to track packages every once in a while is just submitting to this new culture of “forced tipping”. Everyone wants to steady income for just existing. This app used to be free and I USED to use it. I refuse to submit to excessive pay culture. Perhaps advertise up front that this is now a PAID app so people don’t waste their time downloading it.

reviews.title: Not Great Sadly
reviews.text:
This is not a great app. I saw some reviews talking about people losing their deliveries, and that's not what this is about. The app isn't what actually loses the deliveries. It's whatever courier you're using. So that part's ridiculous.

But this app does fail at what it's supposed to do, and that's alerting you when the delivery has been made. In my test, I had two packages that were delivered today, and only one showed up as delivered in the app. The other still shows that it's out for delivery two hours later.

Going into the actual courier website, you can see that it was delivered. So the app is delayed quite extensively by at least two hours for one of the packages when they were both delivered at the exact same time.

reviews.title: Minor Scam Alert
reviews.text:
Firstly, as soon as you enter the tracking number for your parcel the app takes you to a payment screen. 1 year/60$ or weekly with FREE in large letters, then in small print it reads (9.99$/week.) the app is praying on children or the elderly who cannot read the small text and are unknowingly signing up to pay 520$ a year for an app that tells you absolutely nothing new. 

Secondly, as previously mentioned. The app gives you absolutely nothing new! If you already have the tracking number, that means you already know what service is delivering your parcel; connect the two and you will have more information about your package from the delivery service delivering your package! And, it's free!

Dont waste you time or money
